description: This file defines the WindowPlacement enum with static utility functions for calculating and adjusting window frames within screens, primarily for window positioning in a macOS app.

methods.name: centeredFrame(size: on:)
methods.description: Calculates a centered NSRect within a specified screen, defaulting to main screen.

methods.name: topRightFrame(size: padding: on:)
methods.description: Calculates an NSRect positioned at the top-right corner of a specific screen with padding.

methods.name: centeredFrame(size: in:)
methods.description: Calculates an NSRect centered within given bounds.

methods.name: topRightFrame(size: padding: in:)
methods.description: Calculates an NSRect positioned at top right within given bounds.

methods.name: anchoredBelowFrame(size: anchor: padding: in:)
methods.description: Calculates an NSRect positioned below an anchor rect with padding, constrained within bounds.

methods.name: ensureOnScreen(window: defaultSize: fallback:)
methods.description: Adjusts window frame to ensure it is visible on some screen, centering or fallback as necessary.
